purpose: Part 2/5 of verified exact 50-record item effect batch 030; together these files contain exactly 50 reviewed records from the 80-record checkpoint.

items/corn-child.name: Corn Child
items/corn-child.effectSummary: Putting on the mask allows its Ego to possess the wearer until the mask has enriched crops, purified water, provided a feast, and the wearer has gorged on food and drink; the wearer then collapses unconscious. The item is intelligent (Int 12, Wis 18, Cha 16; speech, telepathy, read languages, read magic, darkvision/blindsense/hearing 120 ft.; Ego 18). It can use cure moderate wounds three times per day, purify food and drink three times per day, heroes' feast once per day, and plant growth three three times per day, and has 10 ranks in Knowledge (nature) for a +11 total modifier.

items/cudgel-that-never-forgets-635.name: Cudgel that Never Forgets [Relic]
items/cudgel-that-never-forgets-635.effectSummary: For a lawful-neutral, lawful-good, or neutral wielder, this is a +1 axiomatic heavy mace. With the relic connection to St. Cuthbert it becomes intelligent and sentient (LN; Int 16, Wis 10, Cha 16; speech in Abyssal, Celestial, Common, and Infernal; darkvision 60 ft.; hearing; Intimidate 10 ranks, total +13) and can use cure moderate wounds three times per day. The relic connection requires worship of St. Cuthbert plus either a sacrificed 5th-level divine spell slot or True Believer with at least 9 HD. With a sacrificed 7th-level divine slot or True Believer with at least 13 HD, any foe that hits the wielder with a weapon or natural weapon thereafter causes the cudgel to gain +2 additional enhancement and deal +2d6 damage against that foe, regardless of disguise or shapechanging. During the wielder's turn it normally attempts to demoralize one opponent with Intimidate every round unless it is healing the wielder.

items/dagger-of-denial-639.name: Dagger of Denial [Relic]
items/dagger-of-denial-639.effectSummary: This functions as a +1 unholy dagger for any alignment. It remains sentient even without a relic connection, but if the wielder is not N, LE, NE, or CE it betrays the wielder by dispelling the wielder's and allies' spells when possible. With the relic connection to Vecna it reveals full intelligence (NE; Int 18, Wis 10, Cha 18; speech, telepathy, darkvision 120 ft., blindsense, hearing; Intimidate +13, Spellcraft +14, Bluff +14; Ego 26), detects magic at will, and uses greater dispel magic once per day. The relic connection requires worship of Vecna plus either a sacrificed 6th-level divine spell slot or True Believer with at least 11 HD. With a sacrificed 8th-level divine slot or True Believer with at least 15 HD, it also grants continuous detect scrying and can use arcane eye once per day. It prefers to ready greater dispel magic to counterspell enemy casters.

items/dancing-lantern.name: Dancing Lantern
items/dancing-lantern.effectSummary: The command word 'illuminion' toggles its magical bullseye-lantern light, which consumes no oil, and 'aviallow' toggles levitation/landing. While floating, the owner can direct it verbally as a free action within 1,000 feet; it flies up to 90 feet per round with perfect maneuverability, can rotate its beam freely, and tries to stay within 1,000 feet. It is Tiny, AC 12, 30 hp, hardness 10. Intelligent variants can move on their own and beyond 1,000 feet, typically have Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 14, Ego 7, vision/hearing 120 feet, Common plus two languages, telepathy with the owner within 1,000 feet, 10 ranks in Search, and faerie fire three times per day; the owner can still deactivate their flight by command word.

items/discerningwatcher-696.name: Discerning Watcher
items/discerningwatcher-696.effectSummary: This specific psicrown follows the standard psicrown power-trigger rules and contains 450 power points. It can spend those points only on these powers: aura sight, clairtangent hand, clairvoyant sense, psionic darkvision, remote viewing, and psionic true seeing. The wearer may augment those powers with the crown's own points subject to the standard psicrown limit, cannot add personal power points, and may use their own manifester level if it is higher than the crown's.

items/doss-lute-371.name: Doss Lute
items/doss-lute-371.effectSummary: This masterwork lute grants +2 circumstance on Perform (string instruments) and +3 competence on bardic music checks for countersong, fascinate, and suggestion. A character with at least 6 ranks in Perform (string instruments) can use delay poison, hold person, and mirror image once per day each. A creature holding it without at least 6 ranks in Perform (string instruments) gains one negative level while it is held; the level never causes actual level loss and cannot be removed while the lute is held.

items/ezrylon-448.name: Ezrylon
items/ezrylon-448.effectSummary: This is an intelligent lawful-good +2 demon-bane short sword made of Solanian truesteel, which grants +1 on critical-hit confirmation rolls. Its pommel contains a +4 ring of protection whose deflection bonus works only while the sword is drawn and not when the wielding hand is also wearing another magic ring. The sword has Int 13, Wis 10, Cha 13, empathy, 60-foot vision and hearing, Ego 11, understands Abyssal and Common, can use daze monster three times per day, and has 10 ranks in Knowledge (the planes) for a +11 total modifier.
